verdicts.evidence: The editors row shows "3 editors" on the $0 Free card and "1 editor" on the $12 Solo card.
The Company card shows "$99 / month" above a "Talk to us" button, and every card says only "/ month" without saying whether that is per team or per seat.

All four cards are the same size and style, with the same price weight and the same filled blue buttons, nothing marks any plan as recommended, and the taglines "For small studios" and "For larger groups" are there.
